footer_line: Blushlab is made by ipe Studio:
journal_desc: Notes from making Blushlab, a makeup studio and face-photo game.
home_title: Blushlab: Makeup Studio and My Face
home_desc: Blushlab combines a makeup studio and a My Face mode in one game for iOS and Android, now in development. Try shadow, liner, lashes, blush, lip, brows and lenses on a face, or on your own photo.
hero_h1: Try the look,|on your own face.
hero_lead: Makeup Studio uses face-makeup tools. My Face uses your own photo, processed on your device. Free to start, no ads.
hero_note: In development. Free to start, in-app purchases available, no ads.
board_aria: Illustration of a face with blush, lips and hair, shown with a short look-making bar
card1_p: Apply shadow, liner, lashes, blush, lip, brows and lenses to a face, step by step, and compare the result.
card2_p: Use a photo of your own face. The photo is processed on your device and is not sent to a server.
card3_p: You can start for free. In-app purchases are available, and there are no ads.
rivals_p: Makeup Studio and My Face come together in one game, so you can switch between them as you like.
